description: This file defines classes, structs, and functions related to uniform layout and packing in GLSL and HLSL shaders, including block layout encoders for std140 and std430 standards, and visitor patterns for shader variable traversal.

classes.name: BlockLayoutEncoder
classes.description: Abstract base class for encoding block layouts, providing interface for layout calculation and offset management.

classes.name: DummyBlockEncoder
classes.description: A dummy implementation of BlockLayoutEncoder that returns default values.

classes.name: Std140BlockEncoder
classes.description: Encodes block layout according to the std140 layout standard.

classes.name: Std430BlockEncoder
classes.description: Encodes block layout according to the std430 layout standard.

classes.name: ShaderVariableVisitor
classes.description: Abstract visitor class for traversing shader variables.

classes.name: VariableNameVisitor
classes.description: Visitor that manages variable naming during traversal.

classes.name: BlockEncoderVisitor
classes.description: Visitor that encodes shader variables into block layout information.

methods.name: encodeType
methods.description: Encodes the type of a shader variable, returning its BlockMemberInfo.

methods.name: getCurrentOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset in the layout.

methods.name: getShaderVariableSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a shader variable.

methods.name: enterAggregateType
methods.description: Called when entering a struct or aggregate type.

methods.name: exitAggregateType
methods.description: Called when exiting a struct or aggregate type.

methods.name: getBlockLayoutInfo
methods.description: Retrieves layout info for a specific type.

methods.name: advanceOffset
methods.description: Advances the current offset based on type and layout rules.

methods.name: getBaseAlignment
methods.description: Returns the base alignment for a variable.

methods.name: getTypeBaseAlignment
methods.description: Returns the base alignment for a specific type.

methods.name: GetInterfaceBlockInfo
methods.description: Calculates layout info for interface blocks.

methods.name: GetUniformBlockInfo
methods.description: Calculates layout info for uniform blocks.

methods.name: visitVariable
methods.description: Visits a shader variable during traversal.
